milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gravel patch is a 4x3 area at spawn-relative (4,-1,3) to (7,-1,5), centered around (5,0,4). Max distance reduced to 8 from 16 to prevent trivial satisfaction from spawn position, ensuring the player intentionally navigated toward the gravel.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smooth sandstone slabs are a 3x2 area at spawn-relative (-5,0,6) to (-3,0,7), centered around (-4,0,7). Max distance reduced to 8 to ensure intentional navigation rather than accidental proximity from spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining gold ore with an iron pickaxe drops raw_gold into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 raw_gold, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the strongest mechanical verification — directly checks the mining outcome.

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the anvil at spawn-relative (7,0,10) with max_distance=3 (within Minecraft's block interaction range of ~4.5 blocks). This is the best verifiable proxy for the rename action because the evaluation system's info dict cannot detect custom item names — inventory only exposes type and quantity. The tight distance (3 blocks) ensures the player is close enough to actually interact with the anvil. Scene provides 30 XP levels to make the rename mechanically possible.
